$comment: Opening a pull request is EXTERNAL_WRITE, so the Tool declares idempotency KEYED and the platform supplies the key. The request carries no runId, nodeId, iteration or attempt: the subject is derived from callbackToken (ADR-0004 §10), never claimed by the caller, which is what stops the runtime widening its own authority by asking differently.
